Retention rule (decided here, pending product-owner approval of a formal retention policy): exactly one previous version (retainedPreviousVersions = 1) lives in the same atomic file as 'previous', never chained, with no dated copies or side files; ApplicationSettingsStore::previousValues() exposes it for recovery. retentionKeepsExactlyOnePreviousVersionInTheSameAtomicFile proves it over four saves, a restart and a restore-by-save. Each bad value is repaired to the default with exactly one field-specific diagnostic, leaves every other field byte-equal, is refused by save() and is repaired identically when read from disk. hotkeyMatrixRepairsEachBindingWithoutDiscardingOthers covers valid and normalized triggers, invalid/foreign/oversize/reserved/non-string triggers, an over-limit binding collection, exactly-at-limit collection and cross-action collisions.
